structural_calls: REGIME_RESILIENCE: Test whether stabilization holds after the failed early rebound without presuming a confirmed breakdown.
LEADERSHIP: Require evidence of ETH/BTC stabilization before calling renewed ETH leadership.
ROTATION_TRANSMISSION: Do not infer a durable full-ladder handoff from isolated participation.
BREADTH_PERSISTENCE: Require sustained short-window improvement together with stronger longer-window participation.

FLOW_QUALITY_FRAGILITY: Weigh the early rebound and positive BTC settled flows against ETH weakness, deteriorating breadth and negative settled ETH flows without inferring unavailable spot or sentiment direction.
